# Data and security issues

| Problem | Answer! |
| --- | --- |
| ** How can the privacy of business data be guaranteed?** | Support for SSO identification, synchronization of organizational structures, authority control, local or cloud deployment options, data encryption and operational logs retrospective; specific security capabilities depend on product version, deployment mode and actual configuration. |

## Enterprise-level security systems

| Security dimensions | Standard calibration |
| --- | --- |
| Identity and competence | Support identification, synchronization of organizational structure and hierarchical authority management |
| Data protection | Supporting transmission and storage encryption, specific algorithms and coverage by product version and deployment program configuration |
| Safety | Support security measures such as DDoS protection, subject to product and deployment configuration |
| Audit and early warning | Support operations logs, audit trails and unusual warnings |
| Disaster preparedness and deployment | Support for disaster preparedness configuration and privatization deployment; actual capacity is based on deployment programmes |
| Basis of qualification | The subject has acquired the equivalent of Level 3 and ISO/CMMI, applicable according to the subject, scope and validity of the certificate |
